method: Completed remaining source; ran five unchanged dependency-free original tests against unchanged extracted helpers. No Windows/SQLite engine integration executed.
findings: Five original tests passed: UTF-8 string shortening, local trust-line description, workday-query phrases, timestamp normalization fixtures and session source counts. These establish listed helper fixtures only.

Memory session selection orders and caps 200 database rows before timestamp normalization and stops at a >30minute adjacent gap. Mixed timestamp units, equal-time tie order and sessions longer than200 records remain unqualified.

Path extraction branch labeled Unix path actually searches colon-slash with a preceding alphanumeric character, so ordinary /home/user/file is not recognized by that branch. Explicit URL extraction terminates only at spaces/tabs, not newline. Meeting-domain path construction truncates at hyphen. Source observations; no full title capture runtime.

Process listing splits CSV with line.split(comma); quoted memory counts containing thousands commas therefore split across fields and can misstate memory/scoring. No tasklist or termination action invoked. Process listing subprocess has no timeout and does not check success exit status before parsing stdout.

Unit converter maps KB/MB/GB aliases to powers of1024 and formats non-finite results as empty strings while still returning Some. Decimal-vs-binary naming and overflow behavior require an explicit product contract, not inferred file-size equivalence.

Quicklink/snippet name-match SQL applies LIMIT5 before later score calculation with no ORDER BY relevance; exact keyword/name candidate outside firstfive may be absent. Queries bind values but LIKE wildcards remain active, a query-semantics issue rather than injection. No database engine tests run here.

Steam search inspects only three fixed library locations without libraryfolders discovery and emits every matching manifest without dedupe/sort in that helper. Notes search enumerates directory entries without checking regular-file type or requiring txt extension. These are launcher coverage limits, not content-duplicate logic.
Complete source review of this module does not complete the 268-blob repository. Main Rust/UI/sync modules, lockfiles and visual assets remain outstanding.
